references.text: God warns of sending all His plagues upon Egypt, which is the background for the threats concerning Egypt's diseases.
The Lord promises not to lay any of Egypt's diseases on Israel if they keep His commandments, which is the opposite of the threat in Deuteronomy 28:60.
The Lord promises to keep all the diseases of Egypt away from Israel if they are obedient, contrasting with the curse in verse 28:60.
Earlier in the same chapter, the boils of Egypt are mentioned as part of the curses, which are further elaborated in verse 60.
The continuation of the same theme, where all diseases and plagues not written in the Book of the Law will also come upon the people.
The description of the plague of boils in Egypt, one of the diseases that Israel feared and which God threatens to bring back.
